# Generated Interfaces

This folder contains **auto-generated TypeScript interfaces** and types
derived from the backend API or schema definitions.
These files are not manually edited — they are updated through autogenerated IntelliSense.

---

## Usage Guidelines

- **Do not manually edit** files in this folder — changes will be overwritten
- Import from `@/interfaces/generated` when referencing backend types

---

## Updating Generated Files

> Run `php bin/intellisense`.
